result.interpretation: Holo-Krome's 162 ksi table entry and UNBRAKO's 170 ksi table entry are real manufacturer-family-specific published minimum yield figures. Neither reviewed source identifies the required F606/F606M or F1575 derivation for that figure. Holo-Krome's 'based on ASTM A-574' note is not an explicit test-method statement, and neither manufacturer's figures can be assigned to the current generic A574-labeled SKU. The current material gap therefore remains open. A separately specified manufacturer product could have its own dimensional and method basis evaluated; no alternate is selected here.

A574_yield_source_scope.current_21_preview_scope: Public clean pp1-3 expose the same relevant Table1/not-applicable small-screw0.2%-yield, Note1 design-only153ksi at2% and Table3 test-row limitations. Clause12 is outside the preview; no whole-edition equivalence or derived-yield route is inferred.
A574_yield_source_scope.existing_independent_153_design_yield_re: The historical A574 direct-steel reference remains a declared design-yield comparison; it is not authenticated by this source read as a small-screw0.2%-yield minimum. No stored numerical result or Grade5 route is changed.

primary_facts_from_A574_17.fact: Scope covers alloy-steel hexagon socket-head cap screws of0.060 through4in diameter. Ordering identifies the ASTM issue year and fastener dimensions. The16 current3/8-16 socket-cap labels fit the nominal type/size scope conditionally; this is not delivered conformity.

The0.2%-offset machined-specimen yield row is not applicable in both diameter bands below1in. Its153ksi minimum belongs to the1in-and-larger band. Current3/8in full-size requirements separately give180ksi tensile and140ksi proof stresses; neither is a tensile-yield or bending-yield measurement.

For diameters below1in, a separate design-only note permits assuming153ksi yield at2% offset. The printed note says2%, not0.2%. This is a sourced design assumption, distinct from the table's applicable tested yield requirement. It is preserved here without promoting it to NDS Fyb.

For diameter below1in and length above3D, the applicable route requires full-size wedge tension and the listed hardness/metallurgical tests; proof loading is requested in the order. Machined-specimen0.2%-offset yield is not an applicable test in this row. All16 selected current screws fall in this size/length row.

Section7 mechanical testing and additional purchaser-required mechanical tests use F606/F606M at room temperature. This authenticates the procedure link for applicable tests; it does not insert a tensile-yield minimum into Table1's not-applicable cells or turn proof/wedge tests into yield tests.

ASME B18.3 is the default dimensional type. Exact current body/root/length conditional profile inputs remain those of the separately pinned geometry/profile contract; no dimensional change or new guarantee follows from this material-source read.

NDS permits Fyb based on F1575-derived yield or F606-derived tensile yield. This disposition does not impose a new0.2%-offset requirement on NDS; the unresolved join is whether the design-only A5742%-offset assumption supplies that allowed derived-yield basis. No proof-to-yield or ultimate-to-yield inference is made.

contact_motion.assessment: Contact-set preservation is not demonstrated by the available first-order bank. The reused, current-eight-port probe quantifies kinematic sensitivity but cannot establish the contact set or forces of a finite equilibrated configuration.

known_answer_control.meaning: The fixed-linear-state probe mixes linear neutral translations with finite arms. A pure common rigid rotation represented to first order can therefore produce a surrogate gap; the count is not a physical failure or error bound.

contact_motion.minimum_remaining_method: An objective finite-kinematic contact/beam formulation with consistent neutral motions and normals, or a separately justified conservative contact/load envelope, is needed before these results can qualify finite contact applicability. A small known-answer joint/rigid-motion control precedes any new assembly solve.

limitations: This is only the NDS 2024 reduced-depth sawn-lumber shear component under the recorded conditional material and geometry assumptions; a component ratio at or below 1 is not an NDS, member, or joint pass.

The method compares section_v shear only. Axial force, section_u shear, torsion, bending moments, local shaft bending, bolt bearing/group action, steel flange/angle strength, splitting, and complete load transfer are not combined with it; the complete signed vectors and couples remain preserved in every cut.
Forces are fresh conditional field actions, not a physical demand bound. Actual timber grade/service condition, hole/cut geometry, delivered hardware, and physical force bounds remain unobserved.

The current top/post flange groups remain coupled four-axis angle duties. No row capacity, group factor, Table 12.5.1D steel-side/oblique applicability, connection ownership, or full joint acceptance is inferred.

The 3.4.4.1 equation uses rectangular stock section bounds over each bore band; it does not calculate finished net section at the bolt plane, end tearout, splitting/fracture, or any other failure mode.

method.citation_note: The request mentioned §3.4.3.3; the pinned 2024 NDS source and frozen V10 helper identify this reduced-depth equation as §3.4.4.1(a). This calculation retains that source locator.

conditional_material_scenario.locator: NDS Supplement 2024 Table 4A, sawn Douglas Fir-Larch No. 2 row, Fv=180 psi

method.demand_method: Maximum absolute section_v shear component over both bore bands and one-sided event cuts, using the frozen full-member member_cut_wrench helper with current six-component signed point actions and current affine self-weight. Every cut row retains the complete signed force, moment, and axial component.
method.edge_method: Both opposing unloaded-edge branches are calculated for every flange group; the lesser reference is used for the component ratio. No edge is selected from a net group resultant.
method.equations: Vr'=(2/3)Fv' b de (de/d)^2 for connection less than 5d from end; Vr'=(2/3)Fv' b de at or beyond 5d.

near_washer_fit.conditional_datum_verified: Pinned CAD template has two0..t boxes meeting at outer corner; current fitting pose and response heel origin/u,-w,v basis match. Every near washer host-support point replays at along23.8125mm on the INNER steel face at thickness6.35mm. No wood end was substituted as a steel heel datum.

one_geometric_remedy_for_review.still_require: Suitable hole/metal bearing land, head/fillet/spacer clearance, washer thickness/material and coupled strength. Smaller OD alone is a geometric remedy, not a prying-strength proof.

principal_block_paths.method: AISC360-22 J4-5 as reproduced in Dowswell2025 p60; Ubs0.5, Omega2; retained L/U paths with 12mm net deduction for10mm modeled holes
principal_block_paths.specific_strength_requirements: Fy235 with Fu>=the printed boundary suffices for the listed absolute principal-force equations at t6.35 and the controlled retained grid. This is not a derived minimum for the complete fitting. Normal force, bearing/free couples, eccentric 3D interaction and prying remain separate.

remaining_method.concrete_next_local_design_step: Fix the controlled section/material and flat-land requirement above, then complete a compatible local holed-angle/washer/bolt/unilateral-backing treatment under the existing exact load positions and all saved independent couples; recover interface tractions and bound capture/prying forces. Alternatively match the retained curved-sector lower-bound traction field through the holed flanges. The missing item is that local method, not another global convergence solve or automatic product rejection for unobserved steel grade.
remaining_method.exact_failure: Historical ideal-bend field end tractions are not matched to a field across the straight holed flanges; its Ri=t geometry also did not screen near washer lands. Symmetric T-stub formulas do not accept the present independent six-component root/port actions and compression-only two-row wood backing without a compatible local plate/bolt/contact allocation. Aggregate equilibrium cannot determine or upper-bound the physical prying increment.

disposition.NDS_scope: The saved homogeneous 1/5 proof is conservative for the matched NDS single/symmetric-double EYM modes when effective D>=1/4 in and theta_max<=90 degrees. It does not assign an NDS Rd, Cg, or tabulated capacity to the current unequal three-media topology.
disposition.conditional_one_d_lateral_model: A bounded model-level reference is constructed: each receiver surface is given a nonnegative radial cosine pressure field matching its signed transverse force and first moment; a shared beam field integrates those forces, point gravity and end-capture actions. Bearing and plastic bending limits are explicitly Fe/5 and Fyb/5. This is a lower-bound certificate only for that declared idealized lateral beam/receiver yield model.
disposition.full_wrench_scope: Axial N, transverse section shear V, torsion T, and washer/nut seat forces are reported separately and are not interacted with lateral bearing/flexure. Their combined material and seat resistance remain unresolved; no complete full-wrench or joint pass is claimed.
disposition.material_boundary: Sawn G=0.50 Fe, APA Group 1 minimum plywood Fe, metal-side Fu=370 MPa, Grade 5 Fyb=92 ksi, and A574 Fyb=45 ksi are conditional model inputs. A574 remains at the generic 45 ksi reference; actual Fyb/Fy and delivery are null.
disposition.physical_scope: The cosine pressure field is statically admissible for an ideal zero-gap circular interface. It does not prove physical hole contact, compatibility, gap closure, orthotropic 3D wood stress, delivered thread/body behavior, fitting resistance, or splitting resistance.

matched_mode_calibration_and_limits.boundary: This is an NDS-mode calibration on matched standard two-member mechanisms; the extension is a declared idealized three-media model reference, not an NDS-issued Rd or whole-connection resistance.
matched_mode_calibration_and_limits.effective_diameter_scope: D>=0.25 in; all current mixed-plane effective D/Dr inputs are >=0.2881 in.
matched_mode_calibration_and_limits.homogeneity_proof: For each matched Table 1-1 mechanism, uniformly scaling bearing Fe*D and plastic moment Fyb*D^3/6 by c scales its positive homogeneous mode yield P by c. At c=1/5, P/5<=P/Rd for every current Table 12.3.1B Rd<=5, so min(P/5)<=min(P/Rd). The radial pressure criterion below is stricter than a scalar q<=Fe*D/5 because p0=4|q|/(pi*D)<=Fe/5 implies |q|<=pi*Fe*D/20 < Fe*D/5.

model_definition.construction: The existing affine_surface and bending_field helpers preserve each surface force/first moment, include all current shaft point loads and end captures, and search the continuous polynomial bending field. No force sharing between surfaces or member capacities is summed.
excluded_from_this_model: contact compatibility and nonzero bore gaps
model_definition.receiver_pressure: At each shaft station s and each receiver surface, q(s) is the affine transverse line resultant reconstructed to match the two signed source bearing-cell forces and their first moment. On an ideal zero-gap circle, p(s,phi)=4*|q(s)|/(pi*D)*cos(phi) on the compressive semicircle |phi|<=pi/2; its integral is q(s), and radial traction induces zero torque about the shaft axis.
model_definition.receiver_yield_limit: p0<=Fe/5, using the minimum directional Fe for each wood type and the explicit conditional metal-side Fe=1.5Fu scenario.
model_definition.shaft_bending_limit: |M_perp(s)|<=Fyb*D(s)^3/30, with the conditional body/root profile from the current source-bound shaft records.
